name: Mokele-Mbembe

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Large or smaller, foot, DC 28 basic Reflex save

---

items.name: Whip Tail
items.text:
The mokele-mbembe cracks its tail, creating a sonic boom in a 5-foot burst centered on a corner within reach of its tail Strike.

Each creature in the burst's area must attempt a DC 28 Fortitude save save. Mokele-mbembes are immune.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Stunned 1.

Failure The creature is Stunned 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned 3.

text: Mokele-mbembes are large, reptilian predators found deep within Golarion's jungles. Mwangi view mokele-mbembes as embodiments of nature's strength and majesty, and they consider the sighting of this rare being a sign of favor from the gods and an omen of powerful natural forces. Mokele-mbembes are solitary and excel at going undetected. Most information about them-including the fact that they're voracious predators-comes from following the signs of their passage.
